known_deviations.reason: Real trend after the training years: fewer inside runs gain 1-3 yards in 2024-2025. Predicted 40.3-41.1% across team draws. Joseph accepted this holdout miss in chat on 2026-11-11 after the team-draw sensitivity check (ENGINE_REPORT.md section 1b) showed it outside tolerance under every team draw.

Charting change, not football: FTN marked play action on 0.6% of scrambles in 2022, 8.9% in 2023, 10.4% in 2024 and 12.6% in 2025, while the scramble share of dropbacks held at 10.7-11.2%. Joseph accepted this holdout miss in chat on 2026-11-11 after the team-draw sensitivity check (ENGINE_REPORT.md section 1b) showed it outside tolerance under every team draw.

Real trend after the training years: extra-point success rose in 2024-2025. Predicted 94.1-94.4% across team draws. Joseph accepted this holdout miss in chat on 2026-11-11 after the team-draw sensitivity check (ENGINE_REPORT.md section 1b) showed it outside tolerance under every team draw.
